A full run on 1f307a3 passed (312 unit, 62 parity, 140 e2e). The pre-review of #198, pass 2, then found that the longer German controls hint wrapped one line more and, from 721 px wide, pushed the dock 16 px into the open gas-information panel; every overlap test ran in English. b5860a0 shortens both hints and adds two German overlap tests; the run above is on that commit.

boundsPortedFromTheOracle.frame: src/game-loop.js gameLoop(): dtReal = Math.min(dtReal, 0.1); updateDiving(): dtDiveSeconds = dtReal * timeMultiplier, with timeMultiplier = TIME_ACCELERATION, times FAST_FORWARD_MULTIPLIER while fast-forwarding. The controller passes that frame's dive time to advanceWithBuoyancy() once per display frame.
boundsPortedFromTheOracle.controls: updateDiving(): if (wActive) inflateBCD(dtDiveSeconds, depth); if (sActive) ventBCD(dtDiveSeconds, depth). W or ArrowUp is ascend, S or ArrowDown is descend in the controller.
boundsPortedFromTheOracle.bounds: updateBuoyancyPhysics() clamps at ceilingAt()/floorAt(). The wreck route's 18 m and 34 m, which used to clamp the view, are the bounds.
boundsPortedFromTheOracle.start: Legacy starts at the surface with 2 L (updateSurface). The slice starts at 26 m, so a fresh wreck dive starts neutral there by legacy's neutralizeAt() formula, as pre-v5 saves resume.
boundsPortedFromTheOracle.resume: A resumed dive saved outside 18-34 m (a legacy save, which carries its own depth, velocity and BCD gas) starts at the nearest bound, at rest and neutral there, keeping its deepest point; the physics alone would clamp the depth but keep the gas. v6 marks saved motion as live: v5 saves, written by the fixed-speed client with the model's untouched 2 L, resume at rest and neutral like older saves.
boundsPortedFromTheOracle.hint: src/constants.js controlsText (en and de): 'W = inflate BCD (ascend), S = vent BCD (descend)'. The hint now opens 'W/↑ inflates the BCD, S/↓ vents it, A/D fin.' (de: 'W/↑ füllt das BCD, S/↓ lässt es ab, A/D schwimmen.'), and the up/down buttons' accessible names say the same at length.

tests.added: tests/unit/game-controller-buoyancy.test.ts, 9 tests on a stubbed animation-frame loop: equality with a DiveModel stepped on legacy's frame schedule (20 ms frames at 3x, one 250 ms frame capped to 0.1 s, a fast-forward frame at 30x); W inflating to the 18 m ceiling; S venting to the 34 m floor; the neutral start holding at 26 m; the diver still sinking after S is released; dives saved at 12 m and 40 m starting at the bound, at rest and neutral. tests/unit/save-game.test.ts: a v5 save resumes at rest and neutral, keeping CNS and mode.
adjusted: tests/setup-screen.spec.js 'keyboard and pointer configure the same loop' and 'a closed-circuit dive reaches the same model by touch alone as by keyboard alone' compare the loop's configuration, without the pO2, cylinder pressures, scrubber and CO2 timer, which differ with the first save's frame.
tests/setup-screen.spec.js 'keyboard and pointer reach the same configuration and the same dive' compares the HUD's cylinder pressure within 0.5 bar and requires more than 209.
tests.referenceFrames: wreck-descended re-recorded on win32 with npm run pixi:visual-update after comparing the actual and reference frames: only the diver's height differs (about half a metre of descent in 75 frames instead of 2 m). wreck-exterior-start and wreck-torch-off are byte-identical. The linux frames are recorded by .github/workflows/pixi-baseline.yml, dispatched by owner approval.
